description:
🕒 10:30–13:00

Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

A tour of the Agano area countryside where you can see, hear, and taste the seasons. Konnyaku plants take about three years to grow. Try making konnyaku using traditional cooking methods. You can take home the konnyaku you make.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000, Elementary school students ¥3,000, Preschoolers ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch, etc.)

【Capacity】3 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Kuri-en staff

【What to bring】Drink, apron, bandana/head cloth, towel, mask

【More info】Taira Kuri-en: https://tairakurien.com/

For details, see Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tairakuri-konnyaku-2/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience the countryside with all five senses – make homemade konnyaku (konjac)!
